title: Natural Language Processing: A Comprehensive Practical Guide from Tokenisation to RLHF
abstract: arXiv:2605.03799v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This preprint presents a systematic, research-oriented practicum that guides the reader through the entire modern NLP pipeline --- from tokenisation and vectorisation to fine tuning of large language models, retrieval augmented generation, reinforcement learning from human feedback, prompt engineering, model compression, and multimodal systems. Seventeen hands-on sessions combine concise theory with detailed implementation plans, formalised evaluation metrics, and transparent assessment criteria. The work is not a conventional textbook: it is designed as a reproducible research artefact where every session requires publishing code, models, and reports in public repositories. All experiments are conducted on a single evolving corpus, and the work advocates open weight models over commercial APIs, with special attention to the Hugging Face ecosystem. translated_title: 自然语言处理：从分词到基于人类反馈的强化学习的综合实践指南
translated_abstract: 本预印本呈现了一个系统性、面向研究的实践教程，引导读者贯穿整个现代自然语言处理流水线——从分词和向量化到大语言模型的微调、检索增强生成、基于人类反馈的强化学习、提示工程、模型压缩和多模态系统。十七个动手环节将简洁理论与详细实现计划、形式化评估指标和透明评价标准相结合。这项工作并非传统教科书：它被设计为一个可复现的研究产物，每个环节都要求在公共仓库中发布代码、模型和报告。所有实验均在单一演化语料库上进行，并且该工作倡导使用开放权重模型而非商业API，特别关注Hugging Face生态系统。该材料还包含对低资源语言的原创研究，并融入其中。
tldr: 本论文提供了一套完整的NLP实践教程，涵盖从分词到RLHF的全流程，强调可复现性和开源模型，并融入低资源语言研究。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive NLP practicum covering the full pipeline from tokenisation to RLHF, emphasising reproducibility and open-weight models, with integrated low-resource language research.
